title: docs(pm-dispatch): coordinator opens a review seat on an L2 backlog; route reviews by ownership, thread first
body:
Fixes #34474
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** pm-dispatch 技能四个参考文件的文字：L2 审核排队时协调者自己加开审核席；同项目内请审走线程消息；请审先找本账号自己的审核席，不按席号。
- **为什么改：** 您说「你应该自主决定增加审核席位啊，是技能的问题嘛」「但是用信箱沟通没有的 theads 快和省心」「每个 agent 都可能开 review 席位，这个编号是动态的，你应该首先找自己的」。
- **风险与回滚：** 只改 `.claude/**` 文字，不动代码、不发布；每个文件行数不变（删掉别处已有的重复句来付账）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看：** `references/lanes/l2-review.md` 路由节（请谁、怎么请）；`references/coordinator.md` 第一节新增三行（触发、动作、收席）；`references/project-forms.md` 信箱键那一行。
- **两分钟验证：** `node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`，预期退出 0，四个文件行数等于上限。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地（Tier S）。

## What changes

Skills text only, under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/`:

- `coordinator.md` § 一: an L2 backlog (a ready head waits more than about 30 minutes for its L2 record, or more than about 3 heads are queued per seated reviewer) makes the coordinator open another `l2-review` seat thread itself, without asking the maintainer, and say so in the project chat afterwards. The new seat sits a free seat post, opens its mailbox and splits rows by claim; when the queue drains the extra seat signs off (no idle seats); the usage-wall section (§ 六) still applies.
- `lanes/l2-review.md` § 路由: when to send a review stays in `contract-review.md`; who to ask and how now lives here, never by seat number. A seat asks first the review seats its own account opened (threads of its own project, found from the project's thread list and the `seat-online` posts), and overflows to another account's seats only when every own seat is busy. Inside one project, review requests, deltas and replies to L1/L2 seats go by direct thread message, not a mailbox knock; mailboxes stay for cross-account or cross-project traffic. One line names the split-by-claim rule for N seats. The existing delta line (a delta stays with the reviewer whose record it follows) is unchanged.
- `contract-review.md`: the routing line asks an L2 seat and points at `lanes/l2-review.md` for who and how, instead of "knock a seated L2 seat".
- `project-forms.md`: the `Request: contract-review` mailbox key is scoped to cross-account or cross-project traffic.

Line-neutral in every file (ratchet headroom 0 before and after), paid by deleting restatements whose home is another reference:

- `coordinator.md`: the project-instruction line (home: `project-forms.md` § 指令行即召唤, which also spells the current one-line form); the file-scope meta line (each heading already names its reader); the § 五 analysis line (stated in `lanes/director.md` lines 23-24, and § 五 says it only points).
- `lanes/l2-review.md`: the legacy-spelling line (home: `lanes/review.md`, `SKILL.md` line 52, `project-forms.md` line 13); the security line (home: `security-findings.md` line 46).

Not touched, by the same-file rule (PR #34482 was open when this was written; it has since merged as 495a79c7b3, and the cited line numbers below were re-read on head 0f5619db6e and still hold): `SKILL.md`, `references/area-lease.md`, `references/dispatch-runbook.md`. None of their sentences tells a seat to knock a mailbox for a review or routes by seat number; `SKILL.md` line 51-52, `dispatch-runbook.md` line 220 and `area-lease.md` line 13 (L1 threads) mention review seats neutrally and are named in the report for a follow-up read.

Ruling-ref (verbatim, card #34474 and its two Addition comments 6930630340, 6930675424): 「你应该自主决定增加审核席位啊，是技能的问题嘛」 (2026-11-16T21:37Z), 「但是用信箱沟通没有的 theads 快和省心」 (21:57Z), 「比如 你今天很多审核为什么派给另外一个账户的 review#1，你自己有席位啊」 and 「每个 agent 都可能开 review 席位，这个编号是动态的，你应该首先找自己的」 (21:59Z).

## Tests

No code changed, so no test suite applies. Gates below.

## Acceptance notes

- The card names `review#N` for the new seat's post; the text says `l2-review` because `lanes/l2-review.md` already directs new seats to that spelling.
- No changeset: the diff is `.claude/**` only, which publishes nothing; `skip-changeset` rides the create.

- **Carried, not built here (contract record 6931499577):**
  - S1: `dispatch-runbook.md` line 44 told a seat's patrol to drop its own account's PRs from the TAKE rows, which contradicted the own-seats-first route. Carried by PR #34393 (#34376), which merged as a0056d8154: its line-44 rewrite ("take only the rows that name this seat") is on main and in this head.
  - S2: the L1 half of the thread-message rule needs a line in `area-lease.md`, where the L1 threads live. Carried by #34487, to be built on a main that holds #34482.
  - S3 (merge delta 6932339829): with #34393 on main, its hand-off-names-one-seat rule (`dispatch-runbook.md` line 44, `contract-review.md` line 25, `takerOf`) and this PR's split-by-first-claim rule need one sentence saying which governs. Carried by #34508.

## Verification

Head 0f5619db6e: a merge commit of `origin/main` bdd51769ee into 3dd459fb27 (no rebase, no force), taken after the queue ejected 3dd459fb27 on a conflict with #34393. The PR's delta against main is unchanged: the same 4 files, +9 / -9.

<details><summary>Merge resolution: lanes/l2-review.md (the only conflict; contract-review.md auto-merged)</summary>

Main's two #34393 lines are kept as main wrote them (the session-effort line, and the "本席只兜底" owed-list line, which replaces the old "欠审表 ... 先给 L2 席" line). This PR's routing lines are kept as written (who and how to ask lives here, never by seat number; own account's seats first, overflow to other accounts; thread messages inside one project, mailboxes only across accounts or projects; N seats split by claim; the existing delta line). This PR's deletion of the legacy-spelling line stands.

```
## 路由
- 何时送审只住 contract-review.md 送审路由行;请谁、怎么请只住本节,⛔ 不按席号路由。
- 先请本账号开的审核席(本项目线程,从线程清单与 `seat-online` 帖找);皆忙才溢至他账号席。
- 同项目向 L1/L2 席请审、delta 与回告发线程消息,⛔ 不敲信箱;信箱只留跨账号或跨项目。
- N 席按认领分行:欠审表每个 head 先贴 `Contract-review-claim:` 者持有;后者撤回弃产出。
- 本席只兜底:接哪些 head 只住 contract-review.md 欠审接审行,欠审表 `check-owed-reviews.mjs` 同读
- delta 归原 L2 审核者;L2 席下班留下旧记录 ⇒ 下一 L2 席接 delta,交接行点名它。
```

The merged `contract-review.md` routing line still defers whom and how to ask to `lanes/l2-review.md` ("同笔请 L2 席(请谁照 `lanes/l2-review.md`)"), and #34393's owed-review lines there ("车道达档自审或交接", "L2 席只接 (a) 所点、自记录 delta、他席皆禁之 head") decide which heads an L2 seat takes. The two texts answer different questions (whom a lane asks, versus which heads the fallback seat picks up), so they overlap without contradicting.
</details>
